intent: Make a bedGraph of per-base read coverage from the spliced RNA-seq alignments in rnaseq_sample.bam, so that the coverage of the exons can be displayed in a genome browser.
silent_error: bedtools genomecov -ibam treats every alignment as one block from its start to its end, so the N (skipped region) of a spliced read is counted as covered unless -split is given (bedtools genomecov usage: '-split  Treat "split" BAM or BED12 entries as distinct BED intervals when computing coverage. For BAM files, this uses the CIGAR "N" and "D" operations'). The faulted bedGraph shows a continuous depth of 4 over the whole 200 nt intron (280 covered bases instead of 84) although nothing was sequenced there. Exit 0, valid bedGraph, no message.
